events.speaker: customer
events.text: The washing machine in the laundry room makes a grinding noise and stops midway through a cycle. It is not leaking, and the display has no error code.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: When are you available to meet, and do you already know how much you want to spend on this repair?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: My dentist appointment is Tuesday at ten, so I cannot meet then. I can meet at home Saturday after lunch. Last year I paid one hundred eighty dollars for a different repair, but that is not my budget this time.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Would you like the technician to provide a quote before any work begins?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Yes, please provide a quote before doing any work. I would like to review the price before I authorize a repair.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Do you have an upper spending limit for this visit, separate from the amount you paid for the previous repair?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I have not set a spending limit for this repair yet. Saturday after lunch remains the best time for someone to come.

events.speaker: intake_agent
events.text: Understood. I will use Saturday after lunch as the preference, not Tuesday, and leave the current spending limit unknown.
